purpose: Template for the clean-room calendar SFT dataset register. Copy outside the source tree for each candidate dataset and do not mark it VERIFIED by default.

review.decision_evidence: immutable path or URL to the signed rights decision

records.source_reference: repository-relative path or immutable external URL
records.rights_evidence: licence text, contract, or internal authorship record

required_release_gate: Every record must permit model training and derivative-weight distribution, contain no unapproved personal data, and have review status VERIFIED before a real training run.
